content:
Pleased to have successfully argued a Special Leave Petition (Criminal) before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in a case involving allegations of cheating, forgery and use of forged documents under Sections 318(4), 336(2), 336(3), 338, 340 and 61 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

The appellant, a typist alleged to have merely typed the disputed Will, had remained in custody despite the investigation being complete and the charge sheet having been filed. Recognising the limited role attributed to the appellant and the fact that the case was triable by a Magistrate, the Hon'ble Court granted leave, set aside the High Court's order, and directed his release on bail.
